scripts.title: Universal Animation Menu Keyless
scripts.features:
This script provides an Animation Menu system that allows users to play various animations or emotes easily through a modern and simple user interface.

The menu includes a list of animations that can be played directly, along with a search feature to quickly find specific animations. In addition, users can copy animations from other players in the server using the Copy Emote Player system.

The script also supports Animation Speed and Emote Speed adjustments, allowing users to customize how fast the animations play. For greater flexibility, a Custom Animation ID feature is included, enabling users to run animations manually using their own animation IDs.

Key features and improvements included in this script:

• Animation List
A collection of various animations and emotes that can be played directly from the menu.

• Search Animation
Allows users to quickly find animations through the built-in search system.

• Copy Emote Player
Copies the animation currently being used by other players in the server.

• Lock Animation
Keeps the animation active without being interrupted.

• Speed Control
Adjusts the speed of animations and emotes for a more customized experience.

• Custom Animation ID
Allows users to run animations manually using a specific animation ID.

Overall, this script focuses on usability, flexible animation control, and a clean interface, providing a smoother and more convenient animation experience during gameplay.

scripts.title: No favorite item prompt
scripts.features:
This script automatically removes any PromptFrame elements from Roblox's CoreGui.AvatarEditorPromptsApp, including those nested inside folders like "Children". It scans for existing PromptFrames and destroys them immediately, then continuously monitors for any new ones that appear and removes them on the spot. Useful for blocking avatar editor pop‑ups or cleaning up unwanted UI elements on the client side. Simply execute it via an executor or place it in StarterPlayerScripts for automatic execution.

Auto execute is also recommended.

Enjoy the script!
scripts.script:
-- add us on roblox vincentplayz9356
local coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local avatarEditorPromptsApp = coreGui:WaitForChild("AvatarEditorPromptsApp")

local function killPrompt(inst)
    if inst.Name == "PromptFrame" then
        inst:Destroy()
    end
end

for _, desc in ipairs(avatarEditorPromptsApp:GetDescendants()) do
    killPrompt(desc)
end

avatarEditorPromptsApp.DescendantAdded:Connect(killPrompt)

	local function update(input)

		frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
	
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local function addCorner(obj,r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,r)
	c.Parent = obj
end

local function buttonEffect(button)
	local original = button.Size
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(.15), {Size = original + UDim2.new(.02,0,.02,0)}):Play()
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(.15), {Size = original}):Play()
	end)
end

local function makeDraggable(frame)
	local dragToggle = false
	local dragStart
	local startPos

	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragToggle and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end
